targets.query:
from(bucket: "test-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_execution")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "duration_ms")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "test-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_execution")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["status"] == "PASSED")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "duration_ms")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "test-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_execution")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["status"] == "FAILED")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "duration_ms")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "test-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_execution")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "duration_ms")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "test-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_execution")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "duration_ms")
  |> yield(name: "duration")
